summary.intent: Fix an excessively long release-please changelog on PR #427 by bootstrapping version tags, align api-client versions with the API, and then test the GSD quick workflow by exposing the API version on the /health endpoint.
summary.outcome: Bootstrap tags created for all 15 packages, api-client versions aligned to 0.35.0, openapi.json version made dynamic, PR #428 merged clean, and the /health endpoint updated to expose the API version with unit tests passing.

repo: Release-please generates changelogs from the entire commit history when no prior tags exist — bootstrap tags must be created on the pre-phase commit to establish a baseline.

The project has 15 packages tracked by release-please: root, apps/api, apps/web, apps/desktop, apps/tee-worker, packages/core, packages/crypto, packages/api-client, packages/sdk-core, packages/sdk, crates/crypto, crates/core, crates/api-client, crates/fuse, crates/sdk.

Phase 41 discussion log (.planning/phases/41-package-and-app-versioning-and-release-cycles/41-DISCUSSION-LOG.md:106) specified monotonic (major.minor) versioning for web and desktop apps, but the implementation defaulted to semver — decision was deferred to keep semver for now.
Using `fix:` commit prefix triggers a patch version bump via release-please; CI/tooling-only changes must use `chore(ci):` to avoid unintended version bumps.
openapi.json version was hardcoded as 0.1.0 in both apps/api/src/main.ts and apps/api/scripts/generate-openapi.ts — now reads from npm_package_version with package.json fallback.
release-please extra-files for a nested JSON path (info.version in openapi.json) requires jsonpath syntax, not just a plain file path.
Running `cargo update --workspace` to sync Cargo.lock after a workspace crate version bump is safe — it only changes workspace crate entries without pulling in external dep updates.

code.finding: npm_package_version env var is not reliably set in all environments; fixed to read from package.json as fallback
Same npm_package_version reliability issue; fixed with fail-fast guard if env var missing and no package.json fallback
Extra-files entry for openapi.json uses jsonpath type to target info.version nested field
Health endpoint updated to expose API version; reads from npm_package_version or package.json
Unit test created for the health endpoint version field

workflow: Squashing commits with `git reset --soft <parent>` and recommitting is the clean way to rewrite commit messages before force-pushing, especially when combining multiple WIP commits.
GSD quick workflow: executor runs in a worktree isolation; interrupting it and executing manually requires reading the PLAN.md and following the same commit conventions.
Commit scope matters for release-please: `feat(api):` attributes the change to apps/api and triggers a minor bump; `chore(ci):` is invisible to versioning.
Auto-merge on GitHub PRs requires explicit enablement per-PR — `autoMergeRequest: null` in gh output means it is not active even if the setting exists on the repo.

friction: Git ended up in a detached HEAD state during the commit rewrite, requiring recovery back to the branch before proceeding.

Cargo.lock regeneration via `cargo generate-lockfile` initially pulled in unrelated external dependency updates — had to use `cargo update --workspace` instead to scope changes to workspace crates only.
PR #428 showed auto-merge as enabled in the GitHub UI but `gh pr view` returned `autoMergeRequest: null`, causing confusion about merge status.
The GSD executor was interrupted mid-run, requiring manual execution of the plan with careful attention to commit message conventions.
The executor worktree isolation meant the manually-executed changes had to be done on the original branch, not in the worktree.
open_items: 15 bootstrap tags were created at the pre-phase-41 commit — their correctness should be validated by confirming PR #427 only shows the expected 2 recent changes after re-running release-please.
Web and desktop apps use semver rather than the monotonic (major.minor) versioning agreed in the phase 41 discussion — deferred consciously but should be revisited.

The /health endpoint now exposes the API version but the openapi.json was regenerated via `pnpm api:generate` — the updated openapi.json with version 0.35.0 should be committed if not already included in the quick task commit.
Bootstrap tags were pushed to remote but the release-please workflow was not explicitly re-run in the transcript — PR #427 cleanup should be verified.
